4.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_BYREGOT_000_010
4.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, pleased am I that you should seek me out. As your patron, I had wished to speak with you.
4.translation_description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, mi fa piacere che tu mi abbia cercato. Come tuo patrono, desideravo parlarti.

5.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_BYREGOT_000_011
5.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, pleased am I that you should seek me out. I had wished to speak with you.
5.translation_description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, mi fa piacere che tu mi abbia cercato. Desideravo parlarti.

6.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_BYREGOT_000_012
6.description: It does me well to see that you have been dedicating yourself to crafting. In my capacity as the Builder, I watch your progress upon this path with keenest interest.
6.translation_description: Mi rallegra vedere quanto ti dedichi all'artigianato. In quanto Costruttore, seguo con vivo interesse i tuoi progressi lungo questo cammino.

7.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_BYREGOT_000_013
7.description: Have you been dedicating yourself to crafting, I wonder. In my capacity as the Builder, I watch your progress upon this path with keenest interest.
7.translation_description: Ti stai dedicando all'artigianato, mi chiedo. In quanto Costruttore, seguo con vivo interesse i tuoi progressi lungo questo cammino.

8.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_BYREGOT_000_014
8.description: The act of crafting embodies the spirit of improvement and advancement.
8.translation_description: L'atto di creare incarna lo spirito del miglioramento e del progresso.

9.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_BYREGOT_000_015
9.description: 'Tis my hope that you will strive ever forward, and seize that which you most desire with your own hands.
9.translation_description: Spero che tu possa sempre andare avanti e ottenere con le tue mani ciò che desideri più di ogni altra cosa.

10.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_RHALGR_000_020
10.description: Well, well, if it isn't the dauntless <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Full glad am I that you would thus call to me, your patron.
10.translation_description: Oh, ma guarda chi c'è: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, che non teme nulla! Sono davvero lieto che tu abbia invocato il tuo patrono.

11.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_RHALGR_000_021
11.description: Well, well, if it isn't the dauntless <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Full glad am I that you would thus call to me.
11.translation_description: Oh, ma guarda chi c'è: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, che non teme nulla! Sono davvero lieto che tu mi abbia invocato.

12.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_RHALGR_000_022
12.description: When you and yours investigated the origins of the Fist of Rhalgr, you posited some interesting theories.
12.translation_description: Quando tu e i tuoi compagni avete indagato sulle origini del Pugno di Rhalgr, avete formulato ipotesi interessanti.

13.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_RHALGR_000_023
13.description: The connection between myself and the sylphs' divinity, in particular. You did well to draw that conclusion.
13.translation_description: In particolare, il legame tra me e la divinità dei Silfi. Hai fatto bene a giungere a quella conclusione.

14.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_RHALGR_000_024
14.description: Your inquiring minds have taken you far, child of man, and they will take you further still!
14.translation_description: La tua curiosità, mortale, ti ha portato lontano e ti condurrà ancora più lontano!

19.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_AZEYMA_000_030
19.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, my dearest devotee! At last you've come!
19.translation_description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, anima devota, finalmente sei qui!

21.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_AZEYMA_000_032
21.description: Hehe, I was right to entrust your zealous scholar companion with the message. Ever since our first meeting, I knew that I simply must see you again.
21.translation_description: Eheh, ho fatto bene ad affidare il messaggio a chi ti accompagna nelle ricerche, sempre così zelante. Sin dal nostro primo incontro, sapevo che dovevo assolutamente rivederti.

22.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_AZEYMA_000_033
22.description: There is something familiar about you. You awaken forgotten feelings in me─feelings that once smoldered like embers amidst the ashes.
22.translation_description: C'è qualcosa in te che mi è familiare. Risvegli in me sentimenti dimenticati─sentimenti che un tempo ardevano come braci tra le ceneri.

23.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_AZEYMA_000_034
23.description: Perhaps you resemble someone I knew long ago. Yet whatever the reason, your presence gives me comfort and warmth. May your light ever burn bright!
23.translation_description: Forse assomigli a qualcuno che ho conosciuto molto tempo fa. Qualunque sia la ragione, la tua presenza mi dà conforto e calore. Possa la tua luce continuare a risplendere!

24.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NALDTHAL_000_040
24.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. To you who have given us <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> faith, we bid welcome.

26.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NALDTHAL_000_042
26.description: Know that though we appear to be two beings─a dual-aspected divinity─'twas not always so.
26.translation_description: Sappi che, sebbene sembriamo due esseri─una divinità dai due aspetti─non siamo sempre stati così.

27.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NALDTHAL_000_043
27.description: Man's hopes harbor power, and 'twas his faith, offered over millennia, that shaped us into our present form.
27.translation_description: Le speranze dell'umanità racchiudono potere, e fu la sua fede, offerta per millenni, a plasmarci nella forma attuale.

28.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NALDTHAL_000_044
28.description: In answer to your faith, we, the Traders, shall watch over mankind as he strives for that which he desires.
28.translation_description: In risposta alla vostra fede, noi Mercanti veglieremo sull'umanità mentre insegue ciò che desidera.

34.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NOPHICA_000_050
34.description: Why, if it isn't my faithful <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You wish to speak, do you?
34.translation_description: Ma guarda chi c'è, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, sempre fedele! Desideri parlarmi?

35.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NOPHICA_000_051
35.description: Why, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You wish to speak, do you?
35.translation_description: Ma guarda chi c'è, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Desideri parlarmi?

36.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NOPHICA_000_052
36.description: Tell me, have you ever met an elemental?
36.translation_description: Dimmi, hai mai incontrato un elementale?

37.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NOPHICA_000_053
37.description: Many hold that they were born of me, and as I mentioned, they are the voice of those who abide in the Twelveswood.
37.translation_description: Molti credono che siano nati da me e, come ti dicevo, sono la voce di chi dimora nel Bosco dei Dodici.

38.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NOPHICA_000_054
38.description: At times, they may seem excessive in their actions, but it is out of an abundance of love. So pray be good to them, and heed their warnings!
38.translation_description: A volte le loro azioni possono sembrare eccessive, ma è per l'immenso affetto che provano. Sii gentile con loro e ascolta i loro avvertimenti!

39.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_ALTHYK_000_060
39.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, is it? I must say, there is something to be said for being summoned by a mortal, and one of your own besides.
39.translation_description: Ah, sei <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Devo ammettere che essere evocato da un mortale ha il suo fascino, a maggior ragione se si tratta di uno dei miei.

40.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_ALTHYK_000_061
40.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, is it? I must say, there is something to be said for being summoned by a mortal.
40.translation_description: Ah, sei <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Devo ammettere che essere evocato da un mortale ha il suo fascino.

41.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_ALTHYK_000_062
41.description: The life of man is but a drop in the great river of time. Thus are you and yours wont to rush ahead, not wasting a single moment.
41.translation_description: La vita umana non è che una goccia nel grande fiume del tempo. Perciò tu e i tuoi simili avete l'abitudine di affrettarvi, senza sprecare un solo istante.

42.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_ALTHYK_000_063
42.description: Be that as it may, certain sights will only come into view if one stops to look. So be not afraid to pass the time in ways which, at first, may not seem fruitful.
42.translation_description: Eppure, certi paesaggi si rivelano solo quando ci si ferma a osservarli. Non temere di dedicarti a cose che, a prima vista, sembrano poco fruttuose.

43.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_ALTHYK_000_064
43.description: Should you dare to do so, you may well be visited by an eye-opening experience. Such is the richness of time.
43.translation_description: E, se oserai farlo, potresti vivere un'esperienza che ti aprirà gli occhi. Ecco quanto è ricco il tempo.

44.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_ALTHYK_000_065
44.description: This lesson, I learned in another life from an unexpected visitor.
44.translation_description: L'ho imparato in un'altra vita, da un visitatore inaspettato.

45.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NYMEIA_000_070
45.description: Well now, if it isn't my dear adherent <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. How good of you to call to me.
45.translation_description: Oh, ma guarda chi c'è: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, anima fedele! Che gentile da parte tua farmi visita.

46.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NYMEIA_000_071
46.description: Well now, if it isn't my dear <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. How good of you to call to me.
46.translation_description: Oh, ma guarda chi c'è, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Che gentile da parte tua farmi visita.

47.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NYMEIA_000_072
47.description: I'm sorry if I gave you a shock by joining my brother in battle, but I couldn't help myself. We've always done everything together, he and I.
47.translation_description: Mi dispiace averti spaventato unendomi a mio fratello in battaglia, ma non ho saputo trattenermi. Io e lui abbiamo sempre fatto tutto insieme.

48.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NYMEIA_000_073
48.description: Ah, such a joy it was to face you and yours. You displayed the selfsame determination that allowed you to defy fate, and it was one surprise after another.
48.translation_description: Ah, che gioia è stato affrontare te e i tuoi compagni. Hai mostrato la stessa determinazione che ti ha permesso di sfidare il fato, sorprendendomi a ogni passo.

49.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_NYMEIA_000_074
49.description: Hm, I can't help but feel as though I spoke similar words long ago. Who was it to, I wonder...
49.translation_description: Mh, mi sembra di aver già pronunciato parole simili molto tempo fa. A chi, mi chiedo...

54.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_HALONE_000_080
54.description: How bold you are to summon me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. 'Tis no less than I expect from one of mine.
54.translation_description: È audace da parte tua evocarmi, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Non mi aspetto nulla di meno da chi mi resta fedele.

55.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_HALONE_000_081
55.description: How bold you are to summon me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. 'Tis no less than I expect from you.
55.translation_description: È audace da parte tua evocarmi, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Non mi aspetto nulla di meno da te.

56.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_HALONE_000_082
56.description: In recognition of your valor and deeds, I offer a word of counsel.
56.translation_description: In riconoscimento del tuo valore e delle tue imprese, ti offro un consiglio.

57.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_HALONE_000_083
57.description: Well do I know the power of men's hopes─of mortal faith. And there is no faith that I reject.
57.translation_description: Conosco bene la forza delle speranze umane─della fede dei mortali. Non c'è fede che io respinga.

58.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_HALONE_000_084
58.description: Yet in every age, there are those who invoke the name of the divine for their own ends. Be not misled by them.
58.translation_description: Eppure, in ogni epoca c'è chi invoca il nome del divino per i propri fini. Non lasciarti ingannare.

59.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_MENPHINA_000_090
59.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what a delightful surprise! You wished to see me, did you? Your beautiful and benevolent patron?
59.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, che sorpresa meravigliosa! Desideravi forse vedere me, la tua patrona bella e benevola?

60.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_MENPHINA_000_091
60.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what a delightful surprise! You wished to see me, did you?
60.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, che sorpresa meravigliosa! Desideravi forse incontrarmi?

61.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_MENPHINA_000_092
61.description: I'm truly grateful that we can talk like this.
61.translation_description: Sono davvero felice che possiamo parlare così.

62.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_MENPHINA_000_093
62.description: As you know, I'm the goddess of love. Yet that obviously doesn't mean I have a <hex:021A020203>monopoly<hex:021A020103> on love. For instance, my brethren love mankind with all their hearts, just like me.
62.translation_description: Come sai, sono la dea dell'amore. Ma questo non significa certo che io abbia il <hex:021A020203>monopolio<hex:021A020103> dell'amore. Per esempio, i miei fratelli amano l'umanità con tutto il cuore, proprio come me.

63.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_MENPHINA_000_094
63.description: And whether or not Oschon is my beloved as mortals believe, I have more than enough room in my heart for everyone. Be it men or gods, I love you all alike!
63.translation_description: E che Oschon sia o meno il mio amato, come credono i mortali, nel mio cuore c'è posto per tutti. Che siate mortali o dèi, vi amo tutti allo stesso modo!

64.name: TEXT_CMNCNT65MOEGODS_00841_MENPHINA_000_095
64.description: And needless to say I love my adorable Dalamud too, whom you and yours gifted to me!
64.translation_description: E, naturalmente, amo anche il mio adorabile Dalamud, che tu e i tuoi compagni mi avete donato!
